Yes - I can help you pick the right plan and avatar type. What are you mainly trying to create (training, internal updates, product explainers, sales enablement, customer education, support content, or localization)?
In the meantime, here’s a quick way to choose:
Basic (free): best if you want to try it out with ready-made avatars and no card. Includes 1,200 credits/month (usable for up to 10 minutes of video/month). Available on desktop.
Starter ($19/month): best if you want your own Personal Avatar and 10 minutes of video/month.
Creator ($89/month): best if you need more video time (30 minutes/month) and more workspace seats.
Enterprise: best for bigger teams and unlimited minutes (custom pricing). Available on desktop.
Avatar type:
Stock avatars: ready to use on all plans, best for high-volume, repeatable content (not for promotional content).
Personal avatars: best when a specific person’s presence matters (Starter and above).
Tell me your use case and how many videos you expect to make per month, and I’ll narrow it down.
